Podcast & video
studio in Limassol.

We’re setting up a three-camera room upstairs at Urban Edge for podcasts, YouTube shoots and filmed DJ sets. Bring your guest or your set list. We’ll take care of the controls if you want us to.

01 SESSION GUIDE

What are you making?

Start with what you want to take home. Each session has its own setup, crew options and file handoff.

FORMAT   01↗

Podcasts & interviews

Sit down with a guest. We can look after the levels and switch the cameras while you talk.

FORMAT   02↗

YouTube & tutorials

A desk for a piece to camera, a bench for a demonstration, or a second angle for the detail.

FORMAT   03↗

Business & agency content

Turn the questions customers ask every week into videos your team can actually use.

FORMAT   04↗

DJ sets & artist films

Hands on the decks, the performer in frame and a stereo recording for the edit.

FORMAT   05↗

Livestreams & webinars

Rehearse the opening, check the sound and let a technician handle the live switch.

FORMAT   06↗

Editing & social clips

Trim the false start, add the credits and pull out the moment worth sharing.

UE SECTOR GUIDE

Who is the session for?

Start with the work you do. Here’s how we’d set up the room and plan the files for your team.

FORMAT   07↗

Voiceover & narration

Bring a marked-up script and record the line a second way while you’re still on the mic.

FORMAT   08↗

Course creators & trainers

Film the explanation at the desk, then move in close for the step learners need to see.

FORMAT   09↗

Property teams & agents

Answer the questions buyers ask on viewings, with your own maps, images and branding.

02 ON THE DECKS

Let them see
how you mix.

For an artist promo, the angle on your hands matters as much as the wide shot. Our filmed DJ set concept brings those views together with the stereo feed from the decks.

Explore DJ sessions ↗

03 THE ROOM

One studio, a few different looks.

Pull up two chairs for an interview, take the desk for a tutorial or clear the bench for a demonstration. Try the layouts and put your show name on the screen.

Try the set selector ↗

The Barber’s Chair

Our interview project grew out of the shop. We give someone from Cyprus a chair, a little time and room to tell their story.
